# Versions confirmed to be public releases, one "<component>: <version>" per line.
#
# lstt-hw-health.yml prints a host's version only when its exact line is listed
# here; anything else is reported as "withheld". Workflow logs and summaries on
# this repo are world-readable and the lab runs internal builds, so an unlisted
# version must never be printed. Add a line only after confirming the version
# is a public release.
#
# Confirmed public by the lab team: system BIOS and BMC firmware.
# Not public, never list: the amdgpu driver, ROCm and amd-smi builds on the
# lab hosts (they carry internal, pre-release versions).
